examples.text: Newspaper editors know the importance of putting the most important information “above the fold,” that is, visible when the paper is folded and on the rack.

glosses: The division between the part of a web page visible in a web browser window without scrolling; usually the fold.

examples.text: For example, a story that is "page I, above the fold" is considered very important news. In web page design, the fold signifies the place at which the user has to scroll down to get more information.

I know too much: / I finde it, I; for when I ha liſt to ſleepe, / Mary, before your Ladiſhip I grant, / She puts her tongue alittle in her heart, / And chides with thinking.
examples.translation: I know, [she talks] too much: / I find that, when I have desire to sleep. / Indeed, before your Ladyship I admit, / She keeps a little quiet, / And '''scolds''' me with her thoughts.
